privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.applies_common: This policy applies to all SSAMOK SOFT apps and this website.
privacy.intro: SSAMOK SOFT ("we", "us") explains how we handle information across our apps and this website. Because our apps differ, each app's page includes a data-processing summary specific to that app.
privacy.sum_backend_firebase: Stores data in the Google Firebase cloud.
privacy.sum_backend_supabase: Stores data in the Supabase cloud.
privacy.sum_backend_local: Stores data only on your device (SQLite); nothing is sent to a server.
privacy.sum_account_yes: Signs you in with an account (email).
privacy.sum_account_no: Does not collect any account or email.
privacy.sum_ads_yes: Shows Google AdMob ads; an advertising identifier may be used.
privacy.sum_iap_yes: Offers in-app purchases via the App Store and Google Play.
privacy.s_collect_body: Depending on the app, we collect: an email address (for apps with an account), an advertising identifier (for apps that show ads), and purchase records, receipts, and transaction identifiers (for apps with in-app purchases). Some apps store data only on your device and collect no personal information on a server. We do not collect payment card information.
privacy.s_purpose_body: We use collected information to manage accounts and verify users, operate and provide our services, handle in-app purchases and purchase history, respond to inquiries, improve our services, and deliver advertising.
privacy.s_iap_body: Some apps offer in-app purchases through the App Store and Google Play. Payments are handled by each store; we do not collect or store payment card information. We may process purchase-related information such as receipts and transaction identifiers for purchase validation and support.
privacy.s_thirdparty_body: Depending on the app, we use: Google Firebase (authentication, database, usage analytics, crash analysis), Supabase (backend for upcoming apps), Google AdMob (ad delivery and measurement), and the App Store and Google Play (in-app purchase processing). Apps that store data only on your device do not transmit it to a server. The services each app actually uses are listed in that app's data-processing summary.
privacy.s_ads_body: Some apps may show ads through Google AdMob. An advertising identifier and similar data may be used to deliver and measure ads. You can reset your advertising identifier or limit ad personalization in your device settings.
privacy.s_retention_body: We retain your personal information while your account remains active. Account deletion requested inside an app takes effect immediately; deletion requests received by email (ssamoksoft@gmail.com) are processed within 30 days after identity verification, and we reply with the result. Information that must be kept under applicable law is retained for the required period. In some apps, report records are deleted automatically 90 days after receipt, and the identities concerned are removed earlier if the related account is deleted; copies in disaster-recovery backups expire with the backup retention cycle. App data stored only on your device is deleted when you delete the app.
privacy.s_storage_body: Depending on the app, data is stored in the Google Firebase or Supabase cloud, or only on your device. For cloud-stored data, passwords and sensitive information are encrypted, and we maintain quarterly self-audits, access controls, access logs kept for at least six months, and intrusion prevention and detection systems.
privacy.s_rights_body: You may request to access, correct, delete, or suspend the processing of your personal information, and you can also use the privacy controls provided by the App Store and Google Play.
privacy.s_children_body: Our apps are not directed to children under the age required by applicable law, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.
privacy.s_contact_body: Privacy officer: Dae-hoon Kang. For any privacy question or request, contact us at ssamoksoft@gmail.com.
privacy.s_representative_body: For users in the EU/EEA and the United Kingdom, we have appointed representatives pursuant to Article 27 of the EU GDPR and Article 27 of the UK GDPR. EU representative: Prighter EU Rep GmbH, Schellinggasse 3/10, 1010 Vienna, Austria. UK representative: Prighter Ltd, 20 Mortlake High Street, London, SW14 8JN, United Kingdom. You can contact our representatives and exercise your rights via https://app.prighter.com/portal/19708232400.
privacy.s_changes_body: If this policy changes, we will post the update on this page, and the revised policy takes effect when posted.

kairotique_delete.title: Delete your Kairotique account
kairotique_delete.applies: This page explains how to delete your account and data for the app “Kairotique” by SSAMOK SOFT. You can request deletion without reinstalling the app.

sections.t: Option 1 — Delete in the app (recommended, immediate)
sections.b: In the Kairotique app, go to Settings → Delete account. Your account and data are deleted immediately.

sections.t: Option 2 — Request by email (no app required)
sections.b: From the email address you signed up with, send a message to ssamoksoft@gmail.com with the subject “Kairotique account deletion request”. After identity verification, we will process your request within 30 days and reply with the result.

Your account information (email, nickname, app settings) and every room you created, including all of its records, are deleted immediately. Records you left in rooms created by others are kept as part of that room's history: the content remains, but the author label changes to “(Deleted user)” and your stored display name is removed. If you want a specific record hidden from other participants, contact ssamoksoft@gmail.com.

sections.t: What is retained, and for how long
sections.b: Report records are deleted automatically 90 days after receipt; the reporter's and subject's identities are removed earlier if the account concerned is deleted. Copies in disaster-recovery backups expire with the backup retention cycle. We also ask RevenueCat, the service we use to manage subscription status, to delete your customer record when your account is deleted.

Subscriptions (premium) are separate from account deletion. If you have an active subscription, cancel it directly in Google Play or the App Store — deleting your account does not cancel it automatically.
For questions about deletion, contact ssamoksoft@gmail.com.

kairotique_terms.applies: These terms govern your use of the mobile app “Kairotique” (the “Service”) provided by SSAMOK SOFT (the “Company”). By using the Service, you agree to these terms.

sections.b: Kairotique is a shared log and timer platform where you create rooms and use timers and records together. The Company may improve or change the Service's features over time.

The Service offers premium features via subscription, and payments are processed through the App Store or Google Play. Subscriptions may auto-renew under each store's policy, and cancellations and refunds follow each store's policies and procedures. The Company does not collect or store payment card information, and deleting your account does not cancel a subscription.

You retain your rights to the content you create in the Service, such as rooms, records, and notes. The Company may use that content to the extent needed to provide the Service, including storage, syncing, and display to participants of shared rooms; content posted in a shared room is visible to that room's other participants.

You may not include any of the following in content visible to other users (room titles, preset names, log memos, nicknames): harassment, threats, or hate speech; obscene or violent material; spam or flooding; other people's personal information; or anything that violates applicable law. Disrupting the service, unauthorized access, using another person's account, and reverse engineering, scraping, or automated abuse are also prohibited. When we become aware of a violation through a report or our own review, we remove or hide the content within 24 hours, and for repeated or serious violations we may restrict participation in the room or suspend the account. If your use is restricted, renewal and refunds of paid subscriptions follow the policies of the app stores (App Store, Google Play). You can report inappropriate content with the in-app report feature, hide a specific user's content with the in-app block feature, or send reports to ssamoksoft@gmail.com.

stelleaf_privacy.title: Stelleaf Privacy Policy
stelleaf_privacy.applies: This policy applies to the mobile app “Stelleaf” (별갈피) provided by the sole proprietorship SSAMOK SOFT (the “Operator”). Stelleaf is a local-first app: unless you sign in, all of your data stays on your device only and is never sent to a server.

sections.b: The following sole proprietorship processes personal data as the controller (within the meaning of the GDPR).
l: Business name: SSAMOK SOFT
Owner: Dae-hoon Kang
Privacy officer: Dae-hoon Kang
Contact: ssamoksoft@gmail.com

sections.b: If you use the app without signing in, all data including your records and photos is stored only on your device and nothing is sent to a server. Signing in is optional, and backup and cross-device sync operate only when you are signed in.
Only when you sign in to use backup and sync, the following data is stored on our server (Supabase, Seoul, Republic of Korea region).
l: Account: email address, internal user ID, and sign-in provider identifier — you choose one of email+password, Google sign-in, or Apple sign-in (authentication infrastructure: Supabase Auth)

Content: categories, items (name, notes, product barcode, and place coordinates you explicitly confirmed by dropping a pin on the map), rating records (stars, notes, date, detailed scores, situation tags), item tags, ranking boards, taste-analysis settings, photos, and creation/modification timestamps
Payments: a pseudonymous app user ID, purchase receipts, and device information (processed by RevenueCat) — we never receive payment card details

Maps: the moment you open a map view, the Naver Maps SDK (Korea) or Google Maps SDK (elsewhere) sends a device identifier and approximate location to Naver/Google. Location permission is used only for the “move to my location” feature

Search: only the search query, coordinates, barcode, or ISBN is transmitted. Place search (Naver Cloud), book search (Kakao), and food-barcode lookup (Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety) go through the Operator's server proxy, and requests contain no personally identifiable information. Public databases (Open Food Facts / Open Beauty Facts, OpenLibrary) are called directly by the app with only the barcode or ISBN

sections.b: Photos are re-encoded on your device the moment they are attached, and only a copy with EXIF metadata (including GPS) removed is stored and uploaded. The original photo's GPS is read momentarily on-device only to suggest a location, and is never stored or transmitted. The only coordinates saved to the server are the ones you explicitly confirmed on the map. Cloud photo backup is limited to 200 photos on the free plan and unlimited on Pro; local storage is unlimited on both.
The purposes and legal bases (GDPR Article 6) for each processing activity are:
l: Account management, backup, and cross-device sync — performance of a contract (GDPR 6(1)(b))
Payment and management of the paid subscription — performance of a contract (GDPR 6(1)(b))
Compliance with legal obligations (e.g. retention of payment records) — legal obligation (GDPR 6(1)(c))
There is currently no processing based on separate consent

sections.b: We use the following processors and recipients to provide the service.
l: Supabase — database, authentication, file storage, and server functions (Seoul, Republic of Korea; AWS ap-northeast-2 region)
Naver Cloud — maps and place search (Republic of Korea)
Kakao — book ISBN/title search (Republic of Korea, via server proxy)
Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety — food barcode lookup (Republic of Korea, via server proxy)
RevenueCat — subscription management (United States)
Apple — sign-in and payments (United States)
Google — sign-in, payments, and maps (United States)
Open Food Facts / Open Beauty Facts, OpenLibrary — public databases (only the barcode or ISBN is sent; no personal data)

sections.b: The primary data store (Supabase) is in the Seoul, Republic of Korea region, so your records, photos, and account data are stored domestically and are not transferred abroad. International transfers occur only to the US processors below, on the basis of transfers necessary for the performance of the contract, disclosed in this policy (Article 28-8 of the Korean Personal Information Protection Act). Under the GDPR, transfers from the EEA to Korea rely on the EU adequacy decision for Korea; transfers to the US rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) certification for Google, and on data processing agreements incorporating Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) for Apple and RevenueCat.
l: RevenueCat (US) — data: pseudonymous app user ID, purchase receipts, device information / purpose: subscription status management / retention: as long as needed to manage subscriptions
Apple (US) — data: sign-in identifiers, payment processing data / purpose: Apple sign-in and in-app purchases / retention: per Apple's policies

Google (US) — data: sign-in identifiers, payment processing data, and device identifier and approximate location when using maps / purpose: Google sign-in, payments, and maps / retention: per Google's policies

sections.b: We retain and delete personal data as follows.
l: Account and server data: when you delete your account, all server data (every record, photo file, and the account itself) is deleted immediately and atomically
Deleting individual items, records, or photos: to keep cross-device sync consistent, deleted data is kept in a soft-deleted state for 30 days and then permanently erased

Statutory retention: under the Korean e-commerce act and related laws, records of contracts and withdrawals are kept 5 years, payment and supply records 5 years, and consumer complaint/dispute records 3 years, then destroyed

sections.b: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and data portability. Portability is available directly in the app — Settings > Data > Export records downloads all of your records and photos as a single ZIP file, which the app can also restore from. For any other request, write to ssamoksoft@gmail.com; we respond within one month of receipt (GDPR Art. 12(3)). Where a request is complex we may extend this by two further months and will tell you why within the first month. Users in the EU/EEA and the UK may also exercise their rights through the representative listed in section 10.
l: The export contains: categories, items, rating entries, tags, ranking boards, taste-analysis settings, photos, and the created/updated timestamps of each record
It also contains records that are marked for deletion but not yet purged (within 30 days of deletion)
A file exported while signed in records your account identifier (UUID)
The export file is not encrypted — take care not to share it with others
Complaints: EU residents may lodge a complaint with their national supervisory authority; in Korea, with the Privacy Infringement Report Centre (privacy.kr, 118)

sections.b: For users in the EU/EEA and the United Kingdom, we have appointed representatives pursuant to Article 27 of the EU GDPR and Article 27 of the UK GDPR. EU representative: Prighter EU Rep GmbH, Schellinggasse 3/10, 1010 Vienna, Austria. UK representative: Prighter Ltd, 20 Mortlake High Street, London, SW14 8JN, United Kingdom. You can contact our representatives and exercise your rights via https://app.prighter.com/portal/19708232400.

Stelleaf may only be used by people aged 14 or older (in some EU countries, the applicable consent age of up to 16). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children below these ages, and we delete such data without delay if we become aware of it.
Stelleaf does not do any of the following.
l: No ads, and no collection of advertising identifiers
No selling of personal data
No profiling or automated decision-making
No marketing messages
No intentional collection of data from children under 14

sections.b: We apply reasonable safeguards including encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS), access controls and least privilege, storage in a domestic (Seoul) region, and data minimization. Search API keys are kept only on the server and are never exposed to the client.
If this policy changes, we will post the update on this page, and material changes will also be announced in the app. The revised policy takes effect when posted.

snuumo_privacy.title: Snuumo Privacy Policy
snuumo_privacy.applies:
The Service has only been tested before release and has not been provided to general users. These documents are effective from September 12, 2026 and apply to Service users from public launch. Earlier preparation documents are retained as history.

This Privacy Policy was originally drafted in Korean. This English text is a translation of the Korean original at https://www.ssamoksoft.com/privacy/snuumo/?lang=ko, provided so that users and reviewers who do not read Korean can understand the same content.

SSAMOK SOFT (싸목소프트) (the "Company") provides the memo application "Snuumo" (the "Service") and protects and processes users' personal information as set out below, in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act (개인정보 보호법, "PIPA") and other applicable laws.

sections.t: 1. Personal information collected and how it is collected
l: Category | Items | Method
Account (required) | Email address and password (stored encrypted), or social login identifier (Google · Apple account identifier, email, provider-supplied name and profile-photo URL) | On sign-up

Content | Memo content (text and checklists), attached photos (compressed copies; for Pro, including originals), text recognised in photos (OCR), recognised dictation text that you save, link preview information, reminder times | When the user creates or attaches them (stored on the server for sync and backup purposes)

Location information | Coordinates and place names of memo locations and EXIF coordinates of attached iOS photos. Location metadata is removed from photo files before upload | Only after separate optional location-service consent and enabling Record memo location. Device location also requires OS permission; iOS photo EXIF is separate from OS location permission. Recording can be paused and consent withdrawn in settings

Location-usage records | Account identifier, use time, source, operation and related memo identifier; no actual coordinates, place names, text or photos | Automatically recorded during location processing under Location Information Act Article 16(2)
Location consent state | Current consent status, notice version, decision time and request identifiers | Processing consent and withdrawal and preventing replay of stale requests from other devices

Subscription information | Plan, status and expiry on the Company server; purchase history and receipts/purchase tokens verified and managed by RevenueCat | When checking subscriptions after login, subscribing to Pro or restoring purchases (payment means such as credit card details are handled by the store, such as Apple, and are not collected by the Company)

We do not track users for advertising or collect contacts. Google Sign-In, Maps and ML Kit SDKs may automatically process app/OS/device information, installation or SDK identifiers, feature events, errors, crashes and performance/usage information. RevenueCat processes subscription analytics and a country inferred from the IP address. The external services below explain this processing. Memo text and photo content are not used for advertising or behavioural analytics.

Dictation uses the operating system's speech recognition. Depending on your device, language and settings, audio may be sent to and processed on servers operated by Apple, Google or the speech service provider configured on your device. The Company does not upload or store original dictation audio on its servers. When you save the recognised text as a memo, it is stored on your device and stored and synchronised on the Company servers like other memo text. The provider's processing and retention of audio depend on its policies and your settings. You can type text directly without using dictation.

Text recognition in photos (OCR) is processed on the device. ML Kit may send Google metadata such as image format/resolution, event timing, latency and errors for diagnostics and usage statistics. These statistics do not send the OCR photo or recognised text content.
If a user enters a web address (URL) in a memo, the app connects directly to that website in order to generate a preview (in the course of which the user's IP address is transmitted to that website).

The app accesses the device calendar and reminders only when you export a memo to them. Exported content is passed to the device app and is not sent to or stored on the Company server. The Company does not read your existing events or reminders (on Android, it only checks calendar identifiers so you can select a destination calendar).

The Android app is configured to exclude all app data from Android automatic cloud backups and device-to-device transfers. Snuumo account sync, Pro original photo storage and manual export are separate features. Before erasing your device or reinstalling the app, check the sync status and keep a separate copy of anything not yet synced using [Settings → Export my data].
Creating, authenticating and managing accounts
Providing sync across devices, cloud backup (including Pro original backup) and the memo sharing feature

Location-based search (finding your memos by place name) and map display — locations recorded with memos are not used for any purpose other than this (Terms of Service, Article 10, Location-Based Services)
Verifying subscription status, providing paid features and reviewing subscription analytics
Responding to enquiries, giving service notices and maintaining/improving services using SDK diagnostics, performance and usage statistics
Data | Retention period

All account data and content (memos, photos, profile, share snapshots) | Deleted without delay upon withdrawal of membership ([Settings → Delete account] in the app). If the volume of data is large, the server's clean-up work continues afterwards; once completed, the data cannot be recovered
Memo location information | Deleted on permanent memo deletion, account deletion or withdrawal of location consent. Pausing recording alone does not erase existing locations

Location-usage records | Six months from the event on the device and at least six months from receipt/recording on the server, followed by expiry cleanup. Withdrawal deletes associated records without delay under Article 24(4); account deletion also deletes them

Location consent state and request identifiers | Retained while the account exists to enforce consent and prevent stale-device replays; deleted with the account. No coordinates, place names or memo text
Memos in the trash | Permanently deleted 30 days after being moved there

Share link snapshots | Expire and are deleted 30 days after creation (location information is not included in snapshots, and a snapshot can be deleted at any time before expiry from [Settings → Links I have shared] in the app)
Pro original backups (on subscription cancellation) | Retained for 90 days from the subscription expiry date (viewable and restorable), then deleted

Withdrawal-verification identifier (account identifier and withdrawal time) | Deleted 180 days after withdrawal. Used only to clean up the local data of another device that was still logged in but switched off, when that device connects again
Deletion job records (account identifier, share token, paths of files to be deleted) | Deleted 30 days after deletion is completed. Used only to check for missed deletions and to retry them

Records the Company is legally required to preserve | The period set by the relevant law (for example, 5 years for records of contracts and withdrawal of subscription under the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce (전자상거래 등에서의 소비자보호에 관한 법률))

Upon withdrawal, the local data on the device from which account deletion was carried out is also deleted, without a separate choice, and the local data on other devices logged in to the same account is deleted automatically the next time each such device connects.

In other words, what withdrawal erases is the account, memos, photos, profile, share snapshots and the devices' local data, and what remains is only the withdrawal-verification identifier (180 days) and the deletion job records (30 days) in the table above, together with records the Company is legally required to preserve. The remaining records contain no memo content, photos or location information.
Destruction is carried out by an unrecoverable method (permanent deletion from the database and storage).

We use the services below for authentication, sync, subscriptions and hosting. Supabase and RevenueCat process end-user data on our instructions. We also use Cloudflare as a processor for customer data handled for hosting. Their standard service terms incorporate data processing addenda (DPAs). Login, payment and map platforms, and providers independently handling website visitor information, also apply their own terms and privacy policies.
Provider | Entity / processing location | Purpose and role | Data involved

Supabase Pte. Ltd. | Singapore entity; primary data storage in South Korea (AWS Seoul ap-northeast-2). Support, operations and subprocessors may involve other countries | Processor for authentication, database and photo storage | Account, content, locations, location-usage records, consent state and subscription data in section 1, plus connection/request information. Excludes original dictation audio

Cloudflare, Inc. | US entity; global network | Processor for snuumo.com and share-link landing-page hosting, CDN and security | IP address, request URL (including the share token), time, browser and device information. Our memo database is not replicated to Cloudflare

RevenueCat, Inc. | US; locations governed by the applicable DPA and subprocessor list | Processor for subscription verification, restoration, status and subscription analytics | Snuumo account identifier, product, purchase, receipt or purchase token, subscription status, app/OS/device information, last seen and country information. We do not set or send memo content, photos, audio or email addresses to RevenueCat

Data is sent over the network when you sign in, sync, check subscriptions or use the relevant feature or website. Section 3 describes our retention. Provider operational, connection and transaction records follow their contracts and policies; their retention is not guaranteed to match our memo retention. Cancelling a store subscription and deleting a Snuumo account are separate actions.

To object to transfers or external processing, or request deletion, contact support@ssamoksoft.com. Refusing essential authentication or server sync processing restricts account services. You can avoid optional features, and withdraw location consent and delete existing locations in settings.

If you choose dictation, the audio described in section 1 may be sent to Apple, Google or the speech-recognition provider configured on your device. Provider, processing countries and retention depend on the device, language, settings and provider policy. You can type instead.
Link previews connect from your device to the linked website and preview-image server, disclosing your IP and request URL to those operators. Their policies apply.

We do not sell personal data or provide it for advertising. Section 4 distinguishes processing on our behalf from external platform features you choose. Other third-party disclosures require the necessary consent or a legal basis.

Users may at any time request access to, correction, deletion, suspension of processing or portability of their personal information, or withdraw their consent. Viewing, editing and deleting memos, and deleting the account, can be done directly in the app. Users can export the account's memos, notes and folders stored on this device and available attached photos as JSON and images in a ZIP through [Settings → Export my data] in the app. Some content may be missing if recent changes from another device have not yet synced or photos cannot be retrieved. Original photos are included only when you select the option to include originals and the files can be retrieved. Check the completion notice and snuumo_export.json inside the ZIP for the included photo counts (included) and the omission details (omitted). Separate snapshots created for share links are not included in the export. Other requests are handled if sent to the contact address below.

Response deadline: the Company informs the user of the outcome within one month of receiving the request. Where the request is complex or there are many requests so that it cannot be handled within that period, the period may be extended by up to two further months; in that case the Company informs the user of the extension and the reasons for it within one month of receiving the request (GDPR Article 12(3)).
The Service is not intended for persons under the age of 14 (including persons below a higher minimum age where the law of the user's country or region sets one).

Location use requires separate optional consent. Turning off [Settings → Record memo location] pauses only new recording on this device. [Settings → Withdraw consent and delete locations] erases stored locations, including those in the trash, and associated usage records while keeping memo text, photos, tasks and reminders. This device applies the change immediately; the server and other devices apply it when connected and synced. The app shows offline pending status. Export my data includes location-usage records available from the device and server; server connection failures are listed in the ZIP omission details. Access, correction and notice can also be requested at support@ssamoksoft.com.
Encryption in transit (TLS) to Company authentication/sync servers and one-way encrypted storage of passwords
Per-account access control (a server policy under which only the user's own data is accessible, RLS)
No advertising tracking or advertising identifier collection; management of data needed to provide features
Minimisation of access privileges to personal information

snuumo_terms.title: Snuumo Terms of Service
snuumo_terms.applies:
The Service has only been tested before release and has not been provided to general users. These documents are effective from September 12, 2026 and apply to Service users from public launch. Earlier preparation documents are retained as history.

These Terms were originally drafted in Korean. This English text is a translation of the Korean original at https://www.ssamoksoft.com/privacy/snuumo/terms/?lang=ko, provided so that users and reviewers who do not read Korean can understand the same content. Where a mandatory rule of the user's country of habitual residence provides greater protection, that rule prevails (Article 13).

l: These Terms set out the conditions for using the memo application "Snuumo" and its related services (the "Service") provided by SSAMOK SOFT (싸목소프트) (the "Company"), and the rights and obligations of the Company and the user. Business information of the Company, such as its trade name, representative and contact details, is set out in Article 14.
"Service": the Snuumo app together with all of its sync, backup and sharing features.
"Account": the unit identifying a user, created with an email address or social login (Google · Apple).
"Free plan": the plan provided by default. All features may be used without restriction, except that syncing of compressed copies of photos is limited to 100 photos.
"Pro": the paid subscription plan. The sync volume limit is lifted and original photos are automatically backed up to the cloud.

sections.t: Article 3 (Posting and Amendment of the Terms)
l: The Company posts these Terms on the Service website (snuumo.com) and in the app so that they can be reviewed.

The Company may amend these Terms to the extent that doing so does not violate applicable law. The Company gives notice of an amendment through an in-app notice or by email from 7 days before the effective date (30 days before, for changes unfavourable to users). If a user continues to use the Service after such notice, the user is deemed to have agreed to the amended Terms.
An account is required to use the Service. Users must register with their own accurate information and may not share or transfer their account to another person.

Users may withdraw at any time through [Settings → Delete account] in the app. Upon withdrawal, the user's data stored on the server is deleted without delay; the minimal records that remain after deletion and their retention periods are governed by Article 9 and the Privacy Policy.

The Service may be joined and used only by persons aged 14 or older. Where the law of the user's country or region sets a higher minimum age (for example, up to 16 in some countries), the user must be at least that age.

sections.t: Article 5 (Subscription Products, Payment and Withdrawal of Subscription)
l: Pro is an auto-renewing subscription offered on a monthly and an annual basis. The annual subscription's 7-day free trial is available only to eligible new subscribers as determined by the store. On the App Store it is limited to once per subscription group, and previous trials or subscriptions may make a user ineligible. Applicable trials and prices can be checked on the purchase screen and in the relevant store; prices are displayed in local currency.

Payment, renewal and cancellation are processed through the user's app store account (Apple App Store, etc.). A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancellation is made on the store's subscription management screen on the device.

Refunds follow the refund policy and procedures of the relevant app store operator (the Apple Media Services Terms and Conditions, etc.). The Company does not directly receive or refund store payments.
No charge is made if the subscription is cancelled during the free trial. At the end of the trial the subscription converts automatically to a paid subscription.

Where the Company changes the subscription price, it gives notice at least 30 days in advance, for example by an in-app notice, and users may cancel before the change takes effect. Price increases follow the procedure set by the store (prior notice or user consent); if a user does not consent to an increase that requires consent, the subscription expires at the end of the current billing period.

How to request withdrawal of subscription or a refund: because subscription fees are received by the store, a withdrawal of subscription or a refund is requested from the store where the payment was made (Apple App Store, Google Play) in accordance with that store's procedure. The Company does not directly receive or refund such fees, but will provide guidance on what a user needs in order to follow the store's procedure if contacted at support@ssamoksoft.com. Where applicable law grants the user a right of withdrawal, that right is not restricted by these Terms.

Payments by minors: where a minor has made a payment without the consent of their legal representative, the minor or the legal representative may cancel that payment under the Civil Act (민법). Cancellation and refund are requested through the procedure of the store where the payment was made, as in paragraph 6; the Company supports verification and guidance for enquiries received at support@ssamoksoft.com. Minors must obtain the consent of their legal representative before making a payment.

sections.t: Article 6 (Treatment of Data after Cancellation — the "Freeze" Principle)
l: Even after a Pro subscription expires, the user's data is not deleted:
Memos and photos stored on the device are retained as they are, regardless of the subscription.
Compressed copies that have already been synced are preserved on the server even if they exceed 100 photos; only the syncing of new photos is limited to the free plan level.

Original photo backups are retained and remain viewable for 90 days from the subscription expiry date, after which they are deleted from the server. If the user re-subscribes within that grace period, they are restored as they were. The Company gives notice of the scheduled deletion date through an in-app notice before expiry.

The "unlimited original backup" of Pro presupposes ordinary personal memo use. If any of the following is confirmed, the Company may, after prior notice, limit sync speed or restrict the backup feature:
Bulk storage of files unrelated to memos (such as use as a substitute for a cloud drive)
Bulk uploading using automated tools
Account sharing, resale, or other use outside the normal scope of the Service

Rights in the content a user creates or attaches, such as memos and photos, belong to the user. The Company stores and transmits such content only to the extent necessary to provide the Service, such as for sync, backup and sharing.
Rights in the Service itself (the app, trademarks and design) belong to the Company.
Users must not store or share content on the Service that infringes the rights of others or violates applicable law.

Where content made public through a share link is considered to infringe rights or violate the law, anyone may report it to support@ssamoksoft.com, and the Company will take the necessary measures after review, such as blocking the share link (deleting the snapshot).
Memos moved to the trash are permanently deleted after 30 days (immediate permanent deletion is also possible).
Snapshots created by a share link expire and are deleted 30 days after they are created.

Upon account deletion, all user data on the server (memos, photos, profile and share snapshots) is deleted without delay and cannot be recovered. Where the volume of data is large, the server's clean-up work continues afterwards.

Local data on the device from which account deletion was carried out is deleted together with it, without a separate choice. Local data on other devices that were logged in to the same account is also deleted automatically the next time each such device connects.

Notwithstanding paragraphs 3 and 4, the minimal records needed to clean up other devices and to verify and retry the deletion (the account identifier and deletion time; deletion job records), and records the Company is required by law to preserve, remain for the periods set out in the Privacy Policy.

Users can export the account's memos, notes and folders stored on this device and available attached photos as JSON and images in a ZIP through [Settings → Export my data] in the app. Some content may be missing if recent changes from another device have not yet synced or photos cannot be retrieved. Original photos are included only when you select the option to include originals and the files can be retrieved. Check the completion notice and snuumo_export.json inside the ZIP for the included photo counts (included) and the omission details (omitted). Separate snapshots created for share links are not included in the export.

Under the Act on the Protection and Use of Location Information (the Location Information Act), the Company provides the following information and asks for separate optional consent in the app. Operating-system location permission does not replace this consent. You can use memos, photos, tasks, reminders and sync without agreeing.

Service and purpose: Recording where a memo was written, searching by place name and finding your own memos on a map are basic free features. Location is not used for advertising or profiling and is not sold.

Sources and external processing: After consent, enabling Record memo location allows the current or recent device location (such as GPS) to be used. On iOS, EXIF coordinates in a photo you attach may take priority; this path is separate from OS location permission. EXIF location is not used for Android attachments. Siri follows the same consent and recording setting and uses only an already-authorised recent location. Device-platform geocoding (Apple, Google or another configured provider) converts coordinates to place names and addresses; maps use Google Maps SDK. Coordinates, viewed map areas, IP addresses and other request information may be sent to these providers. The Company stores and synchronises coordinates and place names with the memo on your device and your account server. Location metadata is removed from photo files before upload. Section 4 of the Privacy Policy explains external processing.

Personal location retention: Coordinates and place names are deleted when the memo is permanently deleted, the account is deleted or location consent is withdrawn. A memo in the trash is permanently deleted within 30 days and can also be erased immediately. Movement routes are not collected separately from memos.

Records of location use and provision: Under Article 16(2), the app and server automatically record usage facts such as the account identifier, use time, source (device location, photo EXIF, Siri or stored memo), operation type and related memo identifier. These records do not copy actual coordinates, place names, memo text or photos. Device records are retained for six months from the event; server records for at least six months from receipt or recording. Expired records are removed when the device runs or syncs and by a daily server job. Under Article 24(4), withdrawing consent also deletes the associated usage records without delay; account deletion deletes them too.

Pause and withdrawal: Turning off [Settings → Record memo location] pauses new location recording on this device while retaining existing locations. Revoking OS location permission alone does not withdraw consent for photo EXIF use. Confirming [Settings → Withdraw consent and delete locations] stops new processing and erases existing memo locations, including those in the trash, and the associated usage records. Memo text, photos, tasks and reminders remain. This device is cleared immediately; the request is delivered to the server when connected. Pending status is shown while offline, and other devices apply it at their next connection and sync. Old location data arriving later is checked so it cannot be stored again.

Access, correction and notice: You can view locations in the app and erase them by permanently deleting the memo. [Settings → Export my data] also exports available location-usage records; a server connection failure is noted in the ZIP omission details. You can request access to, notification of, or correction of personal location information and usage records at support@ssamoksoft.com; the Company will not refuse without a legitimate reason. Locations are not arbitrarily disclosed or sold to third parties and are excluded from public share links. If a separate third-party provision under Article 19 is needed, the recipient and purpose will be explained beforehand, consent obtained, and notice provided as required by law.

Restrictions and guardians: Declining or withdrawing consent restricts location recording, place search and maps. Pausing recording alone still allows you to view previously stored locations for which you consented. The Service is for persons aged 14 or older, or the higher minimum age required locally; it does not provide a location-verification service for guardians of children aged eight or under or similar persons.

Company, responsible person and disputes: Company details are in Article 14. The location information manager is Daehoon Kang (Representative), contact support@ssamoksoft.com. Location-information disputes may be referred through the applicable adjudication or mediation procedures of the Korea Media and Communications Commission (kmcc.go.kr) or the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (kopico.go.kr, 1833-6972).

sections.t: Article 11 (Change and Suspension of the Service)
l: The Company may change the content of the Service as necessary for operational or technical reasons.

If the Company terminates the Service, it gives notice at least 30 days in advance and provides a means for users to download their data. For any remaining subscription period, the Company provides guidance on the refund procedure under the store's policy.
The Company is not liable for damage caused by force majeure such as natural disasters or communication failures.

The Service is designed to be local-first, so the original data is preserved on the user's device; nevertheless, users are advised to also maintain a separate backup of important data. The Android app is configured to exclude all app data from Android automatic cloud backups and device-to-device transfers. Snuumo account sync, Pro original photo storage and manual export are separate features. Before erasing your device or reinstalling the app, check the sync status and keep a separate copy of anything not yet synced using [Settings → Export my data].

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Company's liability for damages is limited to the subscription amount actually paid by the user during the preceding 12 months. This limitation does not apply to damage caused by the Company's intent or gross negligence.

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. However, where the country in which the user has their habitual residence as a consumer has mandatory provisions protecting the user, these Terms do not exclude that protection.

Disputes relating to use of the Service are brought before the court having jurisdiction under the Civil Procedure Act (민사소송법); a user who is a consumer may also bring an action before the court of their place of habitual residence.

snuumo_delete.title: Deleting your Snuumo account
snuumo_delete.updated: How to delete your account and data completely

l: Open the Snuumo app and go to Settings.
Tap Delete account at the bottom and confirm as prompted.

As soon as you confirm, deletion of your server data (memos, photos, account) begins, and the local data on this device is deleted together with it, without a separate choice. Local data on other devices that are logged in is deleted automatically the next time each such device connects.

sections.t: If you cannot use the app
l: Please send a request to delete your account to support@ssamoksoft.com from the email address you signed up with. We process it without delay after verifying you (by the request being sent from the sign-up email address).
Account, memos, photos and profile: permanently deleted (unrecoverable). If the volume of data is large, the server's clean-up work continues afterwards; once completed, the data cannot be recovered.
Share links you created and their attachments: deleted together with the account
Local data stored on devices: immediately on the device where deletion was carried out, and on other logged-in devices the next time each connects
The records below contain no memo content, photos or location information.
Record that remains | Retention period | Reason

Withdrawal-verification identifier (account identifier and withdrawal time) | 180 days from withdrawal | To clean up the local data of another device that was still logged in but switched off, when that device connects again
Deletion job records (account identifier, share token, paths of files to be deleted) | 30 days after deletion is completed | To check for missed deletions and to retry them

Records the Company is legally required to preserve | The period set by the relevant law (for example, 5 years for records of contracts and withdrawal of subscription under the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce (전자상거래 등에서의 소비자보호에 관한 법률)) | Legal obligation
For details, see section 3 (Retention periods and destruction) of the Privacy Policy.
